name: Ichiyanagi Nagomu
source:
While he is extremely frightful to the point of fainting, Nagomu will not be satisfied unless he fully investigates the matter he is interested in. He ends up solving most of his cases for this reason. 

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A5%88%E8%90%BD%E3%81%AE%E5%9F%8E_%E4%B8%80%E6%9F%B3%E5%92%8C%E3%80%812%E5%BA%A6%E7%9B%AE%E3%81%AE%E5%8F%97%E9%9B%A3]Wikipedia[/url].]
